rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a place or event that is full of lively activity.

example.english: There is a lot of bustle at the market on weekends.
example.jyutping: go3 si5 zaap6 zau1 mut6 hou2 jit6 naau6

rows.note: Use this when someone is rushing busily and fussily from place to place.

example.english: I bustle from place to place all day just to get everything done in time.
example.traditional: 我成日撲嚟撲去，先至趕得切做晒啲嘢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 jat6 pok3 lei4 pok3 heoi3 sin1 zi3 gon2 dak1 cit3 zou6 saai3 di1 je5
